'''Rale''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Rale was from [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. At one point, he was stationed aboard the cruiser ''[[Coruscani Flame]]''. In [[3643 BBY]] in a period of time known as the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Rale and a few fellow officers were on shore leave to the sprawling city [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] and entered [[Club Ufora]], a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] located in the [[Red Light Sector (Nar Shaddaa)|Red Light Sector]] of Nar Shaddaa's underground. However, to their surprise, his group was locked up and sent elsewhere, while Rale was sent to the the club's back room. Locked up in a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] crate, Rale was unaware of what was going on except that only one officer came back, and he was "different."<ref name="TOR" />

An [[Evocii]] by the name of [[Ilox]] witnessed the group enter the cantina, and saw them never return. Worried that there was trouble, Ilox investigated and found out what was going on. He contacted a Republic-allied individual and asked him to free Rale and any others who may have been trapped. The individual fought his way through armed men and guards, and Rale was freed. He told the individual that he suspected that the remaining officers could have been taken to the [[Quarantine Zone (Nar Shaddaa)|Quarantine Zone]]. Unwilling to let any ill fortune befall the remaining men, the hero quickly headed to the location.<ref name="TOR" />
